title: KAITO — Fury Incarnate〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Was that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, there he is!
Hey, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What do you all want...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nothing big...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We only just met and haven't had a chance to introduce ourselves to you, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, we'd like to take this opportunity to do that♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't think he believes us...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Umm...
We really are here just to say hi...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Fine.
But I'm going to stop listening if I get bored.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, you're okay with us doing this...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, it doesn't look like he's not going anywhere, why don't we dive right in?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll start us off.
My name is Kanade Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ena Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And I'm Mizuki Akiyama!
We make songs together as part of the same music group...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Kanade can do this really cool thing where she measures time in her head super accurately up to like five minutes!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-Is it really that cool...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, Ena loves shopping the snot out of her selfies♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
Snot? That didn't seem necessary...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (When they talk like this, they seem like ordinary people...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Apparently, they all wished to “disappear” at one point or another...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is why they understand how Mafuyu feels.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How do you all feel about her...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Her? Do you mean Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Who else would I be talking about?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Is there a reason why you're so prickly?
You could be a little...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, let's all just calm down!
He did stay and allow us to introduce ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um...
I'm not sure if this will answer your question, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But my goal is to save Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Even though she clearly fears change...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You were there when I spoke to her.
She has no intention of fighting back against her mother.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, that's not true... At least, I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: However, getting Mafuyu's mom to understand is going to be incredibly difficult...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Still, fighting back directly seems like the simplest solution...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I told her no...!
I said that I didn't want to give up music!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But...! She didn't care...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What else can I do at this point...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I need to think of a different way to get her to open up...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, is that all...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Um, yes... We've introduced ourselves, so if you have any questions for us, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Bye...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha... Later, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You were watching...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, but I couldn't quite hear what you were all talking about...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now that you've had a chance to actually talk to them, what do you think? They're an interesting bunch, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hard to say...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, I'll be looking forward to seeing how your opinion of them changes as time progresses.
